message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code runs `dvc pull` to fetch artifacts but does not verify checksums, signatures, or pinned revisions of the downloaded artifacts after retrieval.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection tool is present anywhere in the data preparation code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is applied to the training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The load_model_and_processors function simply unpickles files from a path using pkl.load() with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label set, or anomalous sample distribution before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanism is used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other metric tampering protections; the evaluation simply loads data and computes metrics without integrity checks.
No detected output bounds checks: The prediction result from `get_original_y_class` is returned directly without any NaN checks, probability bounds validation, or sanity checks on the model output.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular salary classification model, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
